mods.name: Level 10 Enchantments
mods.description: Adds loot- and librarian-gated level X enchantments, compatibility features, and a universal 100-level anvil cost cap.

releases.notes:
## English

Level 10 Enchantments 1.5.1 for **Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric**. This is a Beta compatibility release from the verified `mc/26.3` branch.

Rebases all 29 enchantment definitions on official 26.3 resources and adapts registry/tag predicates and the Frost Walker block-state schema. Keeps the 1.5.1 gameplay policy.

Requires **Java 25+, Fabric Loader 0.19.5+ and Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 or a newer compatible 26.3 build**. Use the runtime JAR for Minecraft 26.3; the sources JAR is for development.

Eight policy executables, resource parity, main/client compilation, packaged-JAR validation and Loader/common/client Mixin bootstrap passed. [Successful CI](https://github.com/LIy-hub/level-10-enchantments/actions/runs/37046983086) at `bfab35ea207d2e2e3798a122455c3c68a7c070b6`. The attached JARs retain their original CI bytes; SHA-256 values and metadata are included in the verification manifest.

Dedicated-server/world startup, interactive client/world testing and multiplayer playtests have not yet been verified for 26.3. Automated bootstrap tests do not establish those results. Existing releases for older Minecraft versions remain available separately.

## 中文

Level 10 Enchantments 1.5.1，适用于 **Minecraft 26.3 / Fabric**。本次按 Beta 适配版发布，源码来自已验证的 `mc/26.3` 分支。

按官方 26.3 资源适配全部 29 种附魔定义、注册/标签条件及冰霜行者方块状态格式，保持 1.5.1 的玩法策略。

需要 **Java 25+、Fabric Loader 0.19.5+，以及 Fabric API 0.161.0+26.3 或更新的兼容 26.3 构建**。安装对应 Minecraft 26.3 的运行 JAR；源码 JAR 仅供开发使用。

8 个策略检查程序、资源一致性、公共端与客户端编译、打包 JAR 检查及 Loader/公共端/客户端 Mixin 初始化检查通过。 [CI 构建记录](https://github.com/LIy-hub/level-10-enchantments/actions/runs/37046983086)对应提交 `bfab35ea207d2e2e3798a122455c3c68a7c070b6`。附件保留 CI 原始 JAR 字节，校验和及元数据见验证清单。

26.3 的专用服务器/世界启动、客户端游戏内测试及多人测试尚未验证；自动初始化测试不代表这些测试已完成。旧 Minecraft 版本的发布文件仍单独保留。
